none: Hooray for the President pillow sham.

Pillow sham with multicolor printed woven pat and portraits of Barack Obama. Cloth has dark blue background with portrait of Barack Obama at center. Background has repeating pattern of large pink roses with red leaf, light blue leaf, and brown stem. Portrait of Obama is at center on light green background and framed in black leaf motif with star at top; "Hooray for the President" in stylized banner below portrait. Portrait has white star superimposed on mouth of President. Red fist with "Hope" in brown lettering is below portrait. Black car with "Shine Shine" logo is at base of pillow sham. "Shine Shine" label is sewn in at upper left. Pillow sham edges are reinforced with red stitching; pillow sham back is in plain grey fabric with grey stitching and large overfold to insert pillow.

This collection documents the extraordinary cultural outpouring of celebratory materials from across the continent of Africa.  They represent Africa’s pride in, ownership of and hopefulness for the candidacy and presidency of Barack Obama.
